title: WayFinder+
description: A simple, clean waypoint mod. Set markers anywhere in any dimension and see floating indicators in your HUD showing the name and distance.
body:
# Wayfinder

A lightweight waypoint mod for Fabric. No bloat, no minimap — just clean floating markers that show you exactly where your points are.

## Features

- **Set waypoints anywhere** — overworld, nether, end, or any custom dimension
- **Clean HUD indicators** — a colored icon with your waypoint's name and distance displayed right on screen
- **Per-dimension** — waypoints only show when you're in the right dimension
- **Distance fading** — markers fade out gracefully at long range
- **Full GUI** — add, edit, color, and delete waypoints through a simple in-game screen
- **Persistent** — waypoints save to disk and survive restarts

 Usage

Press the keybind (default: **`B`**) to open the waypoint list.  
Click **Add** to create a new waypoint at your current position.  
Name it, pick a color, and you're done.
 Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
